newsitem.title: GERMANY: UK telesales unit to cut JAL European costs.
newsitem.headline: UK telesales unit to cut JAL European costs.

text.p: Japan Airlines Co Ltd (JAL) said it has centralised European reservations in a new London tele-sales centre to save costs.
Passenger sales offices in Germany, France and Britain have been closed and all enquiries have been handled through the call centre since April 1, a company newsletter said.
Sales offices in all other European countries except for Russia and Turkey will be closed in six months and calls will also be handled in London, it added.
JAL passenger sales director Germany, Jochen Niemann, told Reuters: "We would not do this if it did not save costs but we will first be able to say after a year how much we have saved."
The European call centre, with 34 staff, allowed the airline to be contactable seven days a week from 0700gmt to 1800 gmt for callers instead of only during office hours, he said.
This means for callers from continental Europe, the centre will be open from 0900 to 2000 local time and for UK callers from 0800 to 1900 local.
No jobs would be lost in Germany since five sales staff had transferred to other posts, he said.
